title: Greeting Prompt
description: Use this when you need to generate a warm, context-aware greeting addressed to a named person — accepts {{name}} (required) and {{context}} (optional) to adjust formality and tone.
author: sox-ecosystem

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the person to greet

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Optional context about the greeting situation (e.g. morning standup, onboarding)

config_schema.description: Greeting prompt has no runtime configuration — template variables (name, context) are supplied at render time.
